claims.text: IL-23 inhibitors: risankizumab, guselkumab; ustekinumab targets IL-12 and IL-23. IL-17 inhibitors: secukinumab, ixekizumab
claims.quote: Interleukin (IL)-23 inhibitors: Tildrakizumab, risankizumab, guselkumab, and ustekinumab (targets both IL-12 and IL-23) - IL-17 inhibitors: Secukinumab, ixekizumab, bimekizumab, and brodalumab

claims.text: Apremilast (oral PDE4 inhibitor): data suggest it = less effective than biologics;
claims.quote: Apremilast, a PDE-4 inhibitor, is an oral small-molecule medication for plaque psoriasis; however, data suggest it is less effective than biologics (7).

claims.text: spesolimab (IL-36 inhibitor) treats gen pustular psoriasis
claims.quote: Deucravacitinib is an oral small-molecule agent that inhibits tyrosine kinase 2 and has shown efficacy for treatment of psoriasis (8, 9). Janus kinase inhibitors (eg, tofacitinib, upadacitinib) are used to treat psoriatic arthritis, and also appear to be effective for psoriasis (10); however, more studies are needed before they are routinely used for this indication. Spesolimab is an IL-36 inhibitor that is used for the treatment of generalized pustular psoriasis.

claims.text: Icotrokinra = IL-23-r antagonist for mod-severe plaque psoriasis in adults and children 12 and older weighing ± 40 kg who are candidates for systemic therapy or phototherapy
claims.quote: is an interleukin-23 (IL-23) receptor antagonist indicated for the treatment of moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis in adults and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older who weigh at least 40 kg who are candidates for systemic therapy or phototherapy.
